name: academic-study-support
description: Integrated Academic Study Support System: React + Express + MySQL

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,yellow "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix client
scripts.build: npm install --include=dev --prefix server && npm install --include=dev --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
